decoder.rule: finger_joint_servo_v1: per finger hinge u = strength x (kp x (goal - angle) - kd x hinge speed), one shared factor per finger chain so no command passes its limit, then the actuator range clip; tendons kept
decoder.hold: 25 physics steps of 10 ms (motor_hold 5 x action_repeat 5) under one latched command

regime.note: strength: the finger chain's strength in the latched command (0..1); fatigue_gain: the hand set's capacity at the hold's start (0..1), which scales the actuator gain and force range under body_function modulate; start_speed_rms_deg_s: root mean square of the 44 hinge speeds at the hold's start; goal_minus_start_abs_deg: |goal - start angle| per hinge
